svg.title: Repository publishing structure
svg.desc: RESUME*.md is the factual source for the CV in three languages, which the README profiles summarize. convert.ts, with the page script page.ts, turns CV*.md into CV*.html locally and in the deploy workflow; the workflow adds style.css, fonts, and images with build-site.sh and deploys the site to GitHub Pages at about.violethpark.com.
